G2618.strongs: to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly
senses: κατα-καίω to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.13.30|Mat 13:30]] [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19]]; pass., [[r:1CO.3.15|1Co 3:15]], [[r:HEB.13.11|Heb 13:11]], [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10]], [[r:REV.8.7|Rev 8:7]]; before πυρί [[r:MAT.3.12|Mat 3:12 13:40]], [[r:LUK.3.17|Luk 3:17]] (cf. [[r:EXO.29.14|Exo 29:14]], al.); ἐν πυρί ([[r:DEU.9.21|Deu 9:21]], al.): [[r:REV.17.16|Rev 17:16 18:8]].† (AS)

G2641.strongs: to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining
senses: 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), [[r:MAT.4.13|Mat 4:13]], [[r:MRK.12.19|Mrk 12:19, 21]], [[r:LUK.20.31|Luk 20:31]], [[r:ACT.24.27|Act 24:27 25:14]], [[r:HEB.11.27|Heb 11:27]]; of sailing by a place, [[r:ACT.21.3|Act 21:3]]; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), [[r:MAT.16.4|Mat 16:4 21:17]]; pass., [[r:JHN.8.9|Jhn 8:9]], [[r:1TH.3.1|1Th 3:1]]; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, [[r:2PE.2.15|2Pe 2:15.]]
to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.10.40|Luk 10:40]]; ἐμαυτῷ, [[r:ROM.11.4|Rom 11:4]] (LXX); pass., [[r:HEB.4.1|Heb 4:1]] (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).† (AS)

G2675.strongs: to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust
G2675.kjv: fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore
senses: κατ-αρτίζω to render ἄρτιος, i.e. fit, complete;

to furnish completely, complete, equip, prepare: pass., [[r:LUK.6.40|Luk 6:40]], [[r:ROM.9.22|Rom 9:22]], [[r:HEB.11.3|Heb 11:3]]; mid., [[r:MAT.21.16|Mat 21:16]] (LXX), [[r:HEB.10.5|Heb 10:5]] (LXX); (with) in ethical sense, to prepare, complete, perfect: [[r:GAL.6.1|Gal 6:1]] (EV, restore), [[r:1PE.5.10|1Pe 5:10]]; pass., [[r:1CO.1.10|1Co 1:10]] (Field, Notes, 167), [[r:2CO.13.11|2Co 13:11]], [[r:HEB.13.21|Heb 13:21]] (cf. προ-καταρτίζω).† (AS)

G2662.strongs: to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain
senses: κατα-πατέω, -ῶ to tread down, trample under foot: [[r:MAT.7.6|Mat 7:6]], [[r:LUK.12.1|Luk 12:1]]; pass., [[r:MAT.5.13|Mat 5:13]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5]]. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, [[r:HEB.10.29|Heb 10:29.]]† (AS)

G2647.strongs: to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare) to halt for the night
G2647.kjv: destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down
senses: to destroy, cast down: [[r:MAT.24.2|Mat 24:2]], [[r:MRK.13.2|Mrk 13:2]], [[r:LUK.21.6|Luk 21:6]]; τ. ναόν, [[r:MAT.26.61|Mat 26:61 27:40]], [[r:MRK.14.58|Mrk 14:58 15:29]], [[r:ACT.6.14|Act 6:14]]; οἰκίαν, [[r:2CO.5.1|2Co 5:1]]; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, [[r:GAL.2.18|Gal 2:18.]] Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: [[r:ACT.5.38|Act 5:38-39]]; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.14.20|Rom 14:20]]; τ. νόμον, [[r:MAT.5.17|Mat 5:17]] ([[r:2MA.2.22|2Ma 2:22]]).
to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., [[r:GEN.19.2|Gen 19:2]], al.): [[r:LUK.9.12|Luk 9:12 19:7]].† (AS)

G2648.strongs: to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully
senses: κατα-μανθάνω to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): [[r:MAT.6.28|Mat 6:28.]]† (AS)

κατα-νοέω, -ῶ to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: [[r:ACT.7.31|Act 7:31-32]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.7.3|Mat 7:3]], [[r:LUK.6.41|Luk 6:41 12:24, 27 20:23]], [[r:ACT.11.6|Act 11:6 27:39]], [[r:ROM.4.19|Rom 4:19]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:HEB.3.1|Heb 3:1 10:24]], [[r:JAS.1.23|Jas 1:23-24]] (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).† (AS)
prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with).
κατα-γελάω, -ῶ to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.9.24|Mat 9:24]], [[r:MRK.5.40|Mrk 5:40]], [[r:LUK.8.53|Luk 8:53]].† (AS)

G2680.strongs: to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create
senses: κατα-σκευάζω to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, [[r:MAT.11.10|Mat 11:10]], [[r:MRK.1.2|Mrk 1:2]], [[r:LUK.7.27|Luk 7:27]]; οἶκον, [[r:HEB.3.3|Heb 3:3-4]]; σκηνήν, [[r:HEB.9.2|Heb 9:2]], 6; κιβωτόν, [[r:HEB.11.7|Heb 11:7]], [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]]; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17.]]† (AS)

G2613.strongs: to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty
senses: κατα-δικάζω to pass sentence upon, condemn; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): [[r:MAT.12.7|Mat 12:7]], [[r:JAS.5.6|Jas 5:6]]; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), [[r:LUK.6.37|Luk 6:37]]; pass., [[r:MAT.12.37|Mat 12:37]], [[r:LUK.6.37|Luk 6:37]].† δικάζω, to judge: [[r:LUK.6.37|Luk 6:37]] (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).† (AS)

G2608.strongs: to rend in pieces, i.e. crack apart

senses: κατα-κρίνω to give judgment against, condemn: [[r:ROM.8.34|Rom 8:34]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.14.64|Mrk 14:64]], [[r:JHN.8.10|Jhn 8:10-11]]; disting. fr. κρίνειν, [[r:ROM.2.1|Rom 2:1]], [[r:1CO.11.32|1Co 11:32]]; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), [[r:MAT.20.18|Mat 20:18]], [[r:MRK.10.33|Mrk 10:33]]; pass., [[r:MAT.27.3|Mat 27:3]], [[r:MRK.16.16|Mrk 16:16]], [[r:ROM.14.23|Rom 14:23]], [[r:1CO.11.32|1Co 11:32]], [[r:2PE.2.6|2Pe 2:6]]. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: [[r:MAT.12.41|Mat 12:41-42]], [[r:LUK.11.31|Luk 11:31-32]], [[r:ROM.8.3|Rom 8:3]], [[r:HEB.11.7|Heb 11:7]] † (AS)

G2681.strongs: to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain
senses: κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, [[r:MAT.13.32|Mat 13:32]], [[r:LUK.13.19|Luk 13:19]]; ὑπό, with accusative, [[r:MRK.4.32|Mrk 4:32]]; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, [[r:ACT.2.26|Act 2:26]] (LXX).† (AS)

G2602.strongs: a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception
senses: a laying down: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, [[r:HEB.11.11|Heb 11:11]] (EV, to conceive seed).

a foundation (of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, [[r:MAT.13.35|Mat 13:35]] (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), [[r:MAT.25.34|Mat 25:34]], [[r:LUK.11.50|Luk 11:50]], [[r:HEB.4.3|Heb 4:3 9:26]], [[r:REV.13.8|Rev 13:8 17:8]]; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, [[r:JHN.17.24|Jhn 17:24]], [[r:EPH.1.4|Eph 1:4]], [[r:1PE.1.20|1Pe 1:20]].† (AS)

G2670.root: from [[w:G2596]] and a derivative of the same as [[w:G4195]]
senses: κατα-πονίζω to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: [[r:MAT.14.30|Mat 14:30]]; pass., [[r:MAT.18.6|Mat 18:6.]]† (AS)

G2634.strongs: to lord against, i.e. control, subjugate
G2634.kjv: exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome

G2690.strongs: to turn upside down, i.e. upset
senses: to turn down, turn over; as, the soil.

G2666.strongs: to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively)
senses: to devour: [[r:1PE.5.8|1Pe 5:8.]] Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., [[r:1CO.15.54|1Co 15:54]] (LXX), [[r:2CO.2.7|2Co 2:7 5:4]], [[r:HEB.11.29|Heb 11:29]].† (AS)

G2672.strongs: to execrate; by analogy, to doom
senses: κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. (κατάρα), to curse: with accusative, [[r:MRK.11.21|Mrk 11:21]]; opposite to εὐλογέω, [[r:LUK.6.26|Luk 6:26]], [[r:ROM.12.14|Rom 12:14]], [[r:JAS.3.9|Jas 3:9]]; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): [[r:MAT.25.41|Mat 25:41.]]† (AS)
κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.26.62|Mat 26:62 27:13]], [[r:MRK.14.60|Mrk 14:60]].† (AS)

G2665.root: from a compound of [[w:G2596]] and a congener of [[w:G4072]]
G2665.strongs: something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple
senses: κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό (= cl. παραπέτασμα) in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): [[r:MAT.27.51|Mat 27:51]], [[r:MRK.15.38|Mrk 15:38]], [[r:LUK.23.45|Luk 23:45]], [[r:HEB.6.19|Heb 6:19 9:3]]; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ [[r:HEB.10.20|Heb 10:20.]]† (AS)

G2621.strongs: to lie down, i.e. (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal
senses: to lie sick: [[r:MRK.1.30|Mrk 1:30 2:4]], [[r:JHN.5.6|Jhn 5:6]], [[r:ACT.28.8|Act 28:8]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[r:ACT.9.33|Act 9:33]]; id. with accusative, [[r:LUK.5.25|Luk 5:25]]; ἐν, [[r:JHN.5.3|Jhn 5:3.]]
to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): [[r:MRK.14.3|Mrk 14:3]], [[r:LUK.5.29|Luk 5:29]]; before ἐν, [[r:MRK.2.15|Mrk 2:15]], [[r:LUK.7.37|Luk 7:37]], [[r:1CO.8.10|1Co 8:10]].† (AS)

G2614.strongs: to hunt down, i.e. search for
senses: κατα-διώκω "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116), to pursue closely, follow up
κατα-κόπτω to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. [[r:ISA.27.9|Isa 27:9]], [[r:JER.21.7|Jer 21:7]], [[r:2CH.34.7|2Ch 34:7]]): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, [[r:MRK.5.5|Mrk 5:5.]]† (AS)

G2638.strongs: to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively)
G2638.kjv: apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take
senses: to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: [[r:MRK.9.18|Mrk 9:18]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.9.24|1Co 9:24]], [[r:PHP.3.12|Php 3:12-13]]

to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), [[r:ROM.9.30|Rom 9:30]]; ἡ ἡμέρα, [[r:1TH.5.4|1Th 5:4]]; of evils, [[r:JHN.1.5|Jhn 1:5 12:35]] (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: [[r:JHN.8.3|Jhn 8:3-4]]],

Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): [[r:EPH.3.18|Eph 3:18]]; before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13 10:34]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.25.25|Act 25:25]] (MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

G2646.strongs: properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e. (by implication) a lodging-place
senses: = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), an inn, lodgingplace: [[r:LUK.2.7|Luk 2:7]] (so Ex, l.with, and MGr.).

G2623.strongs: to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate
senses: κατα-κλείω to shut up:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), [[r:LUK.3.20|Luk 3:20]], [[r:ACT.26.10|Act 26:10]].† (AS)
κατα-κρημνίζω (κρημνός), to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: [[r:LUK.4.29|Luk 4:29.]]† (AS)

G2656.strongs: to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to
senses: to make a sign by nodding the head: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.5.7|Luk 5:7.]]† (AS)

G2609.strongs: to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel
senses: κατ-άγω to bring down: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.22.30|Act 22:30]], [[r:ROM.10.6|Rom 10:6]]; id. before εἰς, [[r:ACT.9.30|Act 9:30 23:15, 20 23:28]]; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[r:LUK.5.11|Luk 5:11]]; pass., before εἰς, [[r:ACT.27.3|Act 27:3 2:12]].† (AS)

G2625.strongs: to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place at table
senses: κατα-κλίνω to lay down, make to lie down, esp. for meals: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.9.14|Luk 9:14-15]]; mid., to recline at meals: [[r:LUK.7.36|Luk 7:36 24:30]]; before εἰς, [[r:LUK.14.8|Luk 14:8]] (cf. Jth, Lc.).† (AS)
κατα-πίπτω to fall down: [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6]]; before εἰς, [[r:ACT.26.14|Act 26:14]]; ἐπί with accusative, [[r:LUK.8.6|Luk 8:6.]]† (AS)

G2668.strongs: to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at
senses: κατα-πλέω, -ῶ to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, [[r:LUK.8.26|Luk 8:26.]]† (AS)

G2611.strongs: to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound)

G2694.strongs: to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially
senses: to drag away: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58.]]† (AS)

G2673.strongs: to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively
G2673.kjv: abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void
senses: κατ-αργέω, -ῶ (κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), to make idle or inactive (χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, [[r:LUK.13.7|Luk 13:7.]] Metaphorical (Inscr.), to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish: [[r:ROM.3.3|Rom 3:3, 31]], [[r:1CO.1.28|1Co 1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24]], [[r:GAL.3.17|Gal 3:17]], [[r:EPH.2.15|Eph 2:15]], [[r:2TH.2.8|2Th 2:8]], [[r:2TI.1.10|2Ti 1:10]], [[r:HEB.2.14|Heb 2:14]]; pass., [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14 6:6]], [[r:1CO.2.6|1Co 2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26]], [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7 3:11-14]] [[r:GAL.5.11|Gal 5:11]]; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, [[r:ROM.7.2|Rom 7:2]], 6, [[r:GAL.5.4|Gal 5:4]].† (AS)

G2617.strongs: to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush
senses: κατ-αισχύνω to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.11.4|1Co 11:4-5]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.1.27|1Co 1:27 11:22]]; pass., to be ashamed: [[r:LUK.13.17|Luk 13:17]], [[r:2CO.7.14|2Co 7:14 9:4]], [[r:1PE.3.16|1Pe 3:16]]; as in LXX ([[r:PSA.22.6|Psa 22:6 25:2-3]], al.), of unfulfilled hopes: [[r:ROM.5.5|Rom 5:5]]; pass., [[r:ROM.9.33|Rom 9:33 10:11]], [[r:1PE.2.6|1Pe 2:6]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G2642.strongs: to stone down, i.e. to death
senses: κατα-λιθάζω (= cl. -θόω; cf. -θοβολέω, [[r:EXO.17.4|Exo 17:4]], Num_14:10) to cast stones at, to stone: [[r:LUK.20.6|Luk 20:6.]]† (AS)
κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[r:2TH.1.5|2Th 1:5]]; pass. before inf., [[r:LUK.20.35|Luk 20:35]], [[r:ACT.5.41|Act 5:41]].† (AS)
κατ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ to follow after: [[r:LUK.23.55|Luk 23:55]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.16.17|Act 16:17.]]† (AS)
κατα-μένω to remain permanently, abide: [[r:ACT.1.13|Act 1:13]], [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6]], WH (παραμ-, T, EV).† (AS)
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ to number or count among: before ἐν, [[r:ACT.1.1|Act 1:1.]]† (AS)

G2660.strongs: to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick")
senses: Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, [[r:ACT.2.37|Act 2:37]] (see: κατάνυξις).† (AS)

G2605.kjv: declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach
senses: to pro­claim, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.3.24|Act 3:24 16:21 17:23]]; τ. ἀνάστασιν, [[r:ACT.4.2|Act 4:2]]; τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., [[r:ACT.13.5|Act 13:5 15:36]]; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, [[r:ACT.16.17|Act 16:17]]; φῶς, [[r:ACT.26.23|Act 26:23]]; τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., [[r:1CO.2.1|1Co 2:1]]; τ. εὐαγγέλιον, [[r:1CO.9.14|1Co 9:14]]; τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., [[r:1CO.11.26|1Co 11:26]]; pass., ἄφεσις, [[r:ACT.13.33|Act 13:33]]; ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., [[r:ACT.17.13|Act 17:13]]; ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, [[r:ROM.1.8|Rom 1:8]]; with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, [[r:ACT.17.3|Act 17:3]], [[r:COL.1.28|Col 1:28]]; τ. Χριστόν, [[r:PHP.1.17|Php 1:17]]; pass., [[r:PHP.1.18|Php 1:18.]]
to denounce (Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on [[r:1JN.1.5|1Jn 1:5]]; and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).† (AS)
LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5, 45]].† (AS)

G2686.strongs: to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent

G2669.strongs: to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass)
senses: κατα-πονέω, -ῶ to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., [[r:ACT.7.24|Act 7:24]], [[r:2PE.2.7|2Pe 2:7]].† (AS)
in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease.

G2616.strongs: to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress
senses: κατα-δυναστεύω to exercise power over, oppress: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, [[r:MIC.2.2|Mic 2:2]], [[r:WIS.2.10|Wis 2:10]], al.); with genitive of person(s), [[r:JAS.2.6|Jas 2:6]] (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., [[r:ACT.10.38|Act 10:38]] (cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

G2678.strongs: to sway downward, i.e. make a signal
senses: Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, [[r:ACT.19.33|Act 19:33]]; τ. χειρί, [[r:ACT.13.16|Act 13:16]]; id. with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.21.40|Act 21:40]]; before inf., [[r:ACT.12.17|Act 12:17.]]† (AS)

G2624.root: from [[w:G2596]] and a derivative of a compound of [[w:G2819]] and [[w:G1325]]
G2624.strongs: to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate
senses: to distribute by lot or as an inheritance ([[r:NUM.34.18|Num 34:18]], [[r:JOS.14.1|Jos 14:1]], al.): [[r:ACT.13.19|Act 13:19]].
to receive by inheritance ([[r:DEU.1.38|Deu 1:38]], al.).† κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ, [[r:ACT.13.19|Act 13:19]], Rec., = -νομέω, which see† (AS)

G2664.strongs: to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist

G2645.strongs: left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest)

G2658.strongs: to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively)
senses: κατ-αντάω, -ῶ to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[r:ACT.16.1|Act 16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13]] (see M, Pr., 132) [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12 28:13]]; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, [[r:ACT.20.15|Act 20:15.]] Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.10.11|1Co 10:11 14:36]]; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: [[r:ACT.26.7|Act 26:7]], [[r:EPH.4.13|Eph 4:13]], [[r:PHP.3.11|Php 3:11]].† (AS)
a proclaimer, herald (in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., LAE, 97): with genitive obj., [[r:ACT.17.18|Act 17:18.]]† (AS)

G2698.strongs: to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively)
senses: κατα-τίθημι to lay down, deposit, lay by: [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46]], T; mid., to lay up for oneself: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.24.27|Act 24:27 25:9]].† (AS)
κατά-λαλος, -ου, ὁ a railer, defamer: [[r:ROM.1.30|Rom 1:30.]]† SYN.: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., Syn., § cvii, 15; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G2644.strongs: to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference
senses: κατ-αλλάσσω (Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), [[r:2CO.5.18|2Co 5:18-19]]; pass [[r:ROM.5.10|Rom 5:10]], [[r:2CO.5.20|2Co 5:20]]; of a woman returning to her husband, [[r:1CO.7.11|1Co 7:11]] (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).† (AS)

G2643.strongs: exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor
senses: reconciliation: [[r:ROM.5.11|Rom 5:11]]; κ. κόσμου, [[r:ROM.11.15|Rom 11:15]]; διακονία τῆς κ., [[r:2CO.5.18|2Co 5:18]]; λόγος τῆς κ., [[r:2CO.5.19|2Co 5:19.]]† (AS)
κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό (κατακρίνω), penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): [[r:ROM.5.16|Rom 5:16, 18 8:1]].† (AS)

G2659.strongs: a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with or even with)) stupor (lethargy)
senses: (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: [[r:ROM.11.8|Rom 11:8]] (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).† (AS)
to boast against, exult over: with genitive, [[r:ROM.11.18|Rom 11:18]], [[r:JAS.2.13|Jas 2:13]]; before κατά, with genitive, [[r:JAS.3.14|Jas 3:14]] (T, om. κατά).
before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, [[r:JER.27.38|Jer 27:38]]).† (AS)

G2693.strongs: to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay)

senses: κατα-καλύπτω to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: [[r:1CO.11.6|1Co 11:6]]; τ. κεφαλήν, [[r:1CO.11.7|1Co 11:7.]]† (AS)

G2655.strongs: to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive)
senses: κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ (ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, [[r:GEN.32.25|Gen 32:25]] (26); without Heb. equiv., [[r:GEN.32.32|Gen 32:32]] (33) [[r:JOB.33.19|Job 33:19]], Dan LXX 11:6*);
Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, [[r:2CO.11.9|2Co 11:9 12:13-14]]; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).† (AS)
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ (καταρτίζω), a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, [[r:2CO.13.9|2Co 13:9.]]† (AS)

G2684.strongs: to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously
senses: κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, [[r:GAL.2.4|Gal 2:4.]]† (AS)

G2607.strongs: to note against, i.e. find fault with
senses: κατα-γινώσκω (see: γινώσκω), to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), [[r:1JN.3.20|1Jn 3:20-21]]; pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): [[r:GAL.2.11|Gal 2:11.]]† (AS)

κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ a curse: [[r:GAL.3.10|Gal 3:10, 13]] [[r:HEB.6.8|Heb 6:8]], [[r:2PE.2.14|2Pe 2:14]]; opposite to εὐλογία, [[r:JAS.3.10|Jas 3:10]]; concrete, of Christ, [[r:GAL.3.13|Gal 3:13]] (see Lft. in l).† (AS)

G2699.root: from a compound of [[w:G2596]] and τέμνω (to cut)
senses: excision, concision, mutilation: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, [[r:PHP.3.2|Php 3:2]] (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).† (AS)

G2603.strongs: to award the price against, i.e. (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation)
senses: κατα-βραβεύω (βραβεύς, an umpire, cf βραβεῖον) to give judg­ment against, condemn (see Field, Notes, 196; Abbott, Essays, 104 f.): [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18.]]† (AS)
LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: [[r:1TI.2.9|1Ti 2:9]] (but see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

G2639.strongs: to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol
senses: to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down.
to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., [[r:1TI.5.9|1Ti 5:9]] (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).† (AS)

G2692.strongs: an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy

G2688.strongs: properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor

G2685.root: from [[w:G2596]] (intensive) and [[w:G4649]] (in the sense of a watcher)

G2610.strongs: to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome

G2635.strongs: to be a traducer, i.e. to slander
senses: κατα-λαλέω, -ῶ to speak evil of, rail at: in cl., with accusative; in LXX,
before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, Pr., 65): [[r:JAS.4.11|Jas 4:11]], [[r:1PE.2.12|1Pe 2:12]]; pass., [[r:1PE.3.16|1Pe 3:16]],† (AS)

G2626.strongs: to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge

senses: κατα-σφραγίζω to seal up, secure with a seal: [[r:REV.5.1|Rev 5:1.]]† (AS)
